proof_body:
by
  intro f a b c d hf
  have hi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc c d)
      ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).prod MeasureTheory.volume) :=
    hf.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
  constructor
  · exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod f hi
  · have hi' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry fun x y => f (x, y))
        (((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Icc a b)).prod
          ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Icc c d))) := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict]
      exact hi
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hi'
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc c d) → (∫ z in Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc c d, f z) = (∫ x in Set.Icc a b, ∫ y in Set.Icc c d, f (x, y)) ∧ (∫ x in Set.Icc a b, ∫ y in Set.Icc c d, f (x, y)) = ∫ y in Set.Icc c d, ∫ x in Set.Icc a b, f (x, y)
